definition.en: A group of body parts that work together to carry out a function.
definition.zh: 身体里一起完成某项功能的一组部分。

definition.en: A body part made of different tissues working together to do particular jobs, such as the stomach.
definition.zh: 由不同组织共同构成、完成特定工作的身体部分，例如胃。

definition.en: The breakdown of food into simpler substances that the body can absorb. Chewing and digestive juices contribute in different ways.
definition.zh: 把食物分解成身体能够吸收的更简单的物质。咀嚼与消化液以不同方式参与这个过程。

definition.en: Fluid that helps digestion, such as saliva or the juices released in the stomach and small intestine. Bile also helps the digestion of fat.
definition.zh: 帮助消化的液体，例如唾液以及胃、小肠内的消化液。胆汁也帮助脂肪消化。

definition.en: Fluid released into the mouth that moistens food and begins the chemical digestion of starch.
definition.zh: 分泌到口腔内的液体，润湿食物，并开始分解淀粉。

definition.en: The muscular tube that carries swallowed food from the throat to the stomach. Also called the oesophagus or esophagus.
definition.zh: 把吞下的食物从咽送到胃的肌肉管。英语也叫 oesophagus 或 esophagus。

definition.en: Waves of contraction and relaxation in the tube wall that move its contents along.
definition.zh: 管壁肌肉一波波地收缩和放松，推动里面的东西前进。

definition.en: An expandable organ that holds food temporarily, churns it and mixes it with acidic digestive juice.
definition.zh: 能够扩张的器官，暂存食物，搅拌食物并与酸性的消化液混合。

definition.en: The coiled part of the digestive tube where most digestion and nutrient absorption take place.
definition.zh: 消化道里盘绕的一段，大部分消化与营养吸收在这里进行。

definition.en: Tiny finger-like projections on the lining of the small intestine that increase the area for absorption. One is a villus.
definition.zh: 小肠内壁上细小的指状突起，增加可供吸收的面积。

definition.en: Movement of digested nutrients across the intestinal lining into the body. Many enter blood directly; most fats first pass through lymph.
definition.zh: 消化后的营养穿过肠壁进入身体的过程。许多直接进入血液，大部分脂肪先经淋巴。

definition.en: Fluid made by the liver and stored in the gallbladder. It breaks up large fat drops into smaller ones, helping fat digestion.
definition.zh: 肝制造、胆囊储存的液体，使大的脂肪滴分散成小滴，帮助消化脂肪。

definition.en: The wider part after the small intestine. It absorbs water and salts from the remaining material and forms faeces.
definition.zh: 接在小肠之后较宽的一段，从残余物中吸收水和盐，形成粪便。

definition.en: The material left for removal after digestion and absorption, including undigested food, bacteria and shed cells.
definition.zh: 消化和吸收后要排出体外的物质，包括未消化的食物、细菌与脱落的细胞。

definition.en: The opening at the end of the digestive tube through which faeces leave the body.
definition.zh: 消化道末端的开口，粪便从这里排出体外。
